source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Vigorously scrubbing the treatment area during bathing in order to keep the skin especially clean","B":"Gentle cleansing, avoiding tight clothing over the treatment area, and prompt reporting of significant skin changes","C":"Fairly few specific skin care considerations actually being needed during the course of active radiation treatment","D":"Applying tape or adhesive dressings directly over the radiation treatment field itself"}}
source_row.rationale: Ongoing radiation skin care emphasizes gentle cleansing, avoiding tight clothing or friction over the treatment area, avoiding tape/adhesive directly on the treated skin, and prompt reporting of significant skin changes, supporting skin integrity throughout the treatment course.
